summary: Tightened the prose, corrected the written-question addressee to the European Commission, restored past tense and conclusion dates for the JRC role and the vera.ai and PROMPT projects, fixed the RC51 claim to board service only, and re-anchored MINE's active status to the August 2026 stamp.

flags.claim: earning a citation in a written question to the European Parliament
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states the paper was cited in a written question to the European Commission (a European Parliament document, E-10-2026-000086), not a question addressed to the Parliament. Corrected in the revision.

flags.claim: serving on the Joint Research Centre expert group
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states this role in the past tense (he 'was a member', with summary reports delivered in 2026). The present participle implies an ongoing role the source does not assert. Changed to past tense.

flags.claim: holding memberships in ... the International Sociological Association's Research Committee 51 on Sociocybernetics
flags.issue: The authoritative biography supports only past board service on RC51 ('has served on the board'), not a current membership of RC51 as of August 2026. Revised to state the board service only.

flags.claim: which continues to serve as the primary institutional umbrella for his research
flags.issue: The authoritative biography stamps MINE's active status 'as of August 2026'; the biography converted this into a timeless present-tense claim. The date stamp was restored in the revision.

flags.claim: roles as a work package leader for the vera.ai consortium and as a partner on the PROMPT project
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states both projects concluded (vera.ai in October 2025, PROMPT in February 2026); the biography omitted this, leaving the roles ambiguously current. Conclusion dates added in the revision.
Vague intensifier not grounded in any source; the sources support only the specific citation in a written question and named national media coverage. Replaced with the concrete facts.

flags.claim: Through these initiatives, he explores how emerging technologies reshape public discourse and social systems.
flags.issue: Empty abstraction unsupported as a specific claim by any source; cut in the revision.
